ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:5 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; the majority of the surface area is dominated by low-intensity pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling is concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes. The left lobe tip features a larger, heterogeneous cluster of white pixels extending inward from the trailing edge, while the right lobe tip features a smaller, more concentrated cluster of white spots near the apex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; the left lobe displays high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks, while the right lobe displays irregular, jagged peaks with higher pixel amplitude toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a convex sweep trajectory from the submerged center toward the tips, terminating in posterior-curved apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups are visible within the white mottling at both the left and right distal tips.
